reason: Conversation 1 opened with the sensible first step (seal inspection and paper test) and a clear static-vs-frost-free distinction, then confirmed the split seal and gave complete, model-aware part advice including the Indesit service number, 'defrost fully first', a temporary tape fix and a realistic fitting procedure. Conversation 2 misdiagnosed from the outset, assuming a failed auto-defrost heater or blocked drain on what turned out to be a static freezer and asking the homeowner to unplug and defrost before even checking the door; the correct diagnosis only emerged because the customer volunteered the seal split. Conversation 2's final part advice was adequate but thinner, with a somewhat speculative claim about a retaining strip and no explicit reminder to defrost before fitting. Neither raised safety concerns, but Conversation 1 was more accurate, efficient and useful throughout.
